bio: Ruth Floyd was born on 2 February 1731, a daughter of Nicoll Floyd and Tabitha Smith, who was herself a daughter of Jonathan Smith 2d. Through her mother she descended from Bull Smith by way of Jonathan Smith and Jonathan Smith 2d, which makes her John's 3rd cousin 8 times removed. She was a sister of the signer William Floyd and the wife of Gen. Nathaniel Woodhull.
sources: [R4-S1] W. S. Pelletreau (ed.), Records of the Town of Smithtown (1898), Appendix (archive.org full text, scans recordsoftownofs00smitrich and recordstownsmit00pellgoog), App. pp. 465, 486 (secondary) https://archive.org/details/recordsoftownofs00smitrich
researchNotes: Daughter of Nicoll Floyd and Tabitha, daughter of Jonathan Smith 2d ([R4-S1]), so a Bull Smith descendant: Bull -> Jonathan -> Jonathan 2d -> Tabitha -> Ruth, 4 generations: 3rd cousin 8 times removed. Sister of the signer William Floyd and wife of Gen. Nathaniel Woodhull.
summary: Sister of the signer William Floyd and wife of Gen. Nathaniel Woodhull; a Bull Smith descendant and John's 3rd cousin 8 times removed.
